title: OpenPlanning Resolution Schema v1
description: Formal decisions adopted by a deciding body on Applications. Each Resolution records the outcome (approved, continued, denied, etc.), date, vote, and optional conditions of approval. Natural key: (application, body/jurisdiction, date). Multiple resolutions on the same application are allowed when a case is heard across multiple meetings or bodies (e.g. PC recommends, Town Council ratifies).

source.description: Provenance of this data (e.g. minutes PDF).

application_ref.description: Reference to an Application. Resolved within the named jurisdiction by file_number first, then title.

application.description: The application this resolution applies to.

body.description: Abbreviation of the jurisdiction that adopted this resolution (e.g. 'PC', 'TC', 'BZA'). Must match an existing Jurisdiction.abbreviation within the municipality.

date.description: Date of the decision. Together with application and body this forms the natural key.

outcome.description: Formal outcome adopted by the body.

summary.description: Brief narrative of the decision or discussion (1-3 sentences).

is_final.description: Whether this is the binding final resolution on the application.

conditions.description: Conditions of approval adopted in the motion.
